expected_artifacts: Per-model private fitted boosters/probabilities in unpublished draft Releases. Public commits only configs, hashes, aggregate confusion/per-class metrics and paired comparisons. No official test material.
go_no_go: Treat contextual claim as fragile if intact/full advantage vanishes under shuffled control or on nonoverlapping validation. If improvement persists, require timestamped flow/session external dataset for temporal interpretation.
nonoverlap_window_target_local_indices: 4,9,14,... within each split-local source; zero-based windows 0,5,10,...

training_sampling_effect: intact_nonoverlap vs intact_full on SAME nonoverlap validation subset, but distinct training sample sizes; descriptive

report: Report subgroup scores for five-record windows with all same class versus mixed-class history, plus original CSV source index gap >=10 for the oldest record. These are after-the-fact label-only audits, not input features.
sample_size_caution: Non-overlapping windows reduce sample overlap, not network-flow/session dependence or label/order confounding.
split_caution: Five-fold StratifiedGroupKFold groups by identical 42-feature row tuples; source order still reflects original CSV and classes may be clustered. A new split is not an external validation dataset.
temporal_caution: UNSW 42-feature CSV does not independently demonstrate chronological or same-flow ordering; no claim of actual time modeling.
